dataset: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4) — Global Land-Ocean Temperature Index

units.J-D: annual mean surface-temperature anomaly, degrees Celsius, relative to the 1951-1980 mean
units.JJA: June-July-August mean anomaly, degrees Celsius, relative to the 1951-1980 mean
units.DJF: December-January-February mean anomaly, degrees Celsius, relative to the 1951-1980 mean

licence: Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies).
note: data.csv is a 30-row slice of the source file (years 1996-2025, the most recent complete calendar years). Columns are selected by header name and kept in the source's own order. The 2026 row was excluded because the year is incomplete. Values are copied unchanged; a leading '.' means zero-point, as in the source.
